name: maplibre-gl-handwriting
description: Freehand drawing on a MapLibre GL JS map, tessellated with lyon in WebAssembly

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tests/tools/copy-wasm-types.mjs
scripts.build:demo: npm run build:wasm && vite build --mode demo
scripts.deploy:demo: npm run build:demo && npx wrangler@4.151.3 pages deploy dist/demo --project-name maplibre-gl-handwriting --branch main
scripts.check: npm run build:wasm && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.e2e: node tests/tools/e2e-example.mjs && node tests/tools/e2e-dev.mjs && node tests/tools/e2e-demo.mjs
